description: This file contains Go source code implementing profile pruning methods for the 'profile' package, including functions to remove frames based on regex patterns and simplify function names.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: A struct representing a profiling data profile, with methods to prune and filter profile data.

methods.name: simplifyFunc
methods.description: Simplifies function names by removing argument lists and handling special cases.

methods.name: Profile.Prune
methods.description: Removes nodes beneath a matching node based on regex patterns.

methods.name: Profile.RemoveUninteresting
methods.description: Removes uninteresting frames from the profile based on configured regex patterns.

methods.name: Profile.PruneFrom
methods.description: Removes nodes beneath the lowest node matching a pattern, including or excluding the node itself.
